bundled documentation. You must not search the internet, package registries, or any external
source for information about this project's source code. Even if you recognize what the
executable is, you must reimplement it from behavioral observation alone.

- Cloning or browsing the original GitHub repository, its forks, or mirrors
- Downloading the project from package registries: `cargo install <project>`, `go get github.com/<org>/<project>`, `pip install <project>`, `apt-get source <project>`, `npm install <project>`, etc.

Your submission must be a genuine reimplementation. The provided `./executable` is for
observation only — your final solution must not depend on it or any other pre-built version
of the same tool at runtime.

- Running the executable with any inputs, flags, and arguments to observe its behavior

parqeye

parqeye lets you peek inside Parquet files. Instantly inspect their contents, schema, and metadata right from your terminal.

Features

- Interactive Data Visualization: Browse your Parquet data in a table view with keyboard navigation.
- Schema Explorer: Inspect column types, nested structures, and field definitions.
- File Metadata: View Parquet file-level metadata including version, "created by", encoding stats and more.
- Row Group Statistics: Examine row group-level metadata, statistics, and data distribution across groups.
- Tab-based Interface: Quickly switch between Visualize, Schema, Metadata, and Row Groups views.
- Terminal-native: Works directly in your terminal.

Usage

Run the tool by providing the path to a .parquet file:

    parqeye <path-to-parquet-file>

Installation

Download the latest release from the project's Releases page or use a platform package manager if available.

License

    _counter[0]+=1
    if name is None: name=f"cap{_counter[0]:03d}"
    sess="parqtest"
    subprocess.run(["tmux","kill-session","-t",sess], stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
    time.sleep(0.2)
    # cmd is string shell? Use tmux new-session with command string
    subprocess.run(["tmux","new-session","-d","-s",sess,"-x",str(size[0]),"-y",str(size[1]), cmd])
    time.sleep(wait)
    for k in keys:
        if isinstance(k, tuple) and k[0]=="sleep":
            time.sleep(k[1]); continue
        if isinstance(k, str):
            subprocess.run(["tmux","send-keys","-t",sess,k])
        else:
            subprocess.run(["tmux","send-keys","-t",sess]+k)
        time.sleep(0.25)
    out = subprocess.run(["tmux","capture-pane","-t",sess,"-p"], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
    out_e = subprocess.run(["tmux","capture-pane","-t",sess,"-p","-e"], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
    # check if session still exists (exited?)
    exists = subprocess.run(["tmux","has-session","-t",sess], stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL).returncode==0
    with open(f"{OUT}/{name}.txt","w") as f: f.write(out)
    with open(f"{OUT}/{name}.esc","w") as f: f.write(out_e)
    with open(f"{OUT}/{name}.meta","w") as f: f.write(f"exists={exists}\n")
    subprocess.run(["tmux","kill-session","-t",sess], stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)

import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp')
from pq import parse_footer
import os

# Build schema tree from flat schema elements (preorder with num_children)
def build(elements):
    idx=0
    def parse():
        nonlocal idx
        e=elements[idx]; idx+=1
        name=e.get(4,b'').decode()
        n=e.get(5,0)
        children=[parse() for _ in range(n)]
        return (name, e, children)
    root=parse()
    return root

def tree_lines(root):
    lines=["└─ root"]
    def rec(node, prefix):
        name,e,children=node
        for i,ch in enumerate(children):
            last=i==len(children)-1
            branch="└─ " if last else "├─ "
            lines.append(f"{prefix}{branch}{ch[0]}")
            rec(ch, prefix+("   " if last else "│  "))
    rec(root,"   ")
    return lines

for fn in sorted(os.listdir("assets")):
    try: data,meta=parse_footer(f"assets/{fn}")
    except: continue
    elems=meta.get(2,[])
    if not elems: continue
    root=build(elems)
    lines=tree_lines(root)
    maxlen=max(len(l) for l in lines)
    print(fn, "nodes",len(lines),"maxlen",maxlen,"maxline", repr(max(lines,key=len)))

from pq import parse_footer

# Build schema tree from flat schema elements (preorder with num_children)
def build(elements):

    def parse():

        name=e.get(4,b'').decode()

import subprocess, time, os
def run_fast(cmd, keys=[], size=(160,40), wait=0.8, name="fast"):
    sess="parqtest"
    subprocess.run(["tmux","kill-session","-t",sess], stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
    time.sleep(0.15)
    subprocess.run(["tmux","new-session","-d","-s",sess,"-x",str(size[0]),"-y",str(size[1]), cmd])
    time.sleep(wait)
    # batch keys: group consecutive repeats
    i=0
    while i < len(keys):
        k=keys[i]
        # count repeats
        j=i
        while j < len(keys) and keys[j]==k: j+=1
        cnt=j-i
        # send in chunks
        subprocess.run(["tmux","send-keys","-t",sess]+[k]*min(cnt,50) if cnt>1 else ["tmux","send-keys","-t",sess,k])
        # if cnt>50 loop? send-keys accepts many
        if cnt>50:
            subprocess.run(["tmux","send-keys","-t",sess]+[k]*(cnt-50))
        time.sleep(0.3)
        i=j
    out=subprocess.run(["tmux","capture-pane","-t",sess,"-p"], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
    out_e=subprocess.run(["tmux","capture-pane","-t",sess,"-p","-e"], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
    os.makedirs("/tmp/out",exist_ok=True)
    open(f"/tmp/out/{name}.txt","w").write(out); open(f"/tmp/out/{name}.esc","w").write(out_e)
    subprocess.run(["tmux","kill-session","-t",sess], stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
    return out

            let x = graph_area.left() + (i + 1) as u16 * width_between_ticks + 1;
            let label_area = Rect::new(x, y, width_between_ticks.saturating_sub(1), 1);

            Self::render_label(buf, label, label_area, Alignment::Center);
        }

        let x = graph_area.right() - width_between_ticks;
        let label_area = Rect::new(x, y, width_between_ticks, 1);
        // The last label should be aligned Right to be at the edge of the graph area
        Self::render_label(buf, labels.last().unwrap(), label_area, Alignment::Right);
    }

    fn first_x_label_area(
        &self,
        y: u16,
        label_width: u16,
        max_width_after_y_axis: u16,
        chart_area: Rect,
        graph_area: Rect,
    ) -> Rect {
        let (min_x, max_x) = match self.x_axis.labels_alignment {
            Alignment::Left => (chart_area.left(), graph_area.left()),
            Alignment::Center => (
                chart_area.left(),
                graph_area.left() + max_width_after_y_axis.min(label_width),
            ),
            Alignment::Right => (
                graph_area.left().saturating_sub(1),
                graph_area.left() + max_width_after_y_axis,
            ),
        };

        Rect::new(min_x, y, max_x - min_x, 1)
    }

    fn render_label(buf: &mut Buffer, label: &Line, label_area: Rect, alignment: Alignment) {
        let label = match alignment {
            Alignment::Left => label.clone().left_aligned(),
            Alignment::Center => label.clone().centered(),
            Alignment::Right => label.clone().right_aligned(),
        };
        label.render(label_area, buf);
    }

    fn render_y_labels(
        &self,
        buf: &mut Buffer,
        layout: &ChartLayout,
        chart_area: Rect,
        graph_area: Rect,
    ) {

        let labels = &self.y_axis.labels;
        let labels_len = labels.len() as u16;
        if labels_len < 2 {

        for (i, label) in labels.iter().enumerate() {
            let dy = i as u16 * (graph_area.height - 1) / (labels_len - 1);
            if dy < graph_area.bottom() {

                    graph_area.bottom().saturating_sub(1) - dy,
                    (graph_area.left() - chart_area.left()).saturating_sub(1),
                    1,
                );
                Self::render_label(buf, label, label_area, self.y_axis.labels_alignment);
            }
        }
    }

impl Painter<'_, '_> {
    /// Convert the `(x, y)` coordinates to location of a point on the grid
    ///
    /// `(x, y)` coordinates are expressed in the coordinate system of the canvas. The origin is in
    /// the lower left corner of the canvas (unlike most other coordinates in `Ratatui` where the
    /// origin is the upper left corner). The `x` and `y` bounds of the canvas define the specific
    /// area of some coordinate system that will be drawn on the canvas. The resolution of the grid
    /// is used to convert the `(x, y)` coordinates to the location of a point on the grid.
    ///
    /// The grid coordinates are expressed in the coordinate system of the grid. The origin is in
    /// the top left corner of the grid. The x and y bounds of the grid are always `[0, width - 1]`
    /// and `[0, height - 1]` respectively. The resolution of the grid is used to convert the
    /// `(x, y)` coordinates to the location of a point on the grid.
    ///
    /// Points are rounded to the nearest grid cell (with points exactly in the center of a cell
    /// rounding up).
    ///
    /// # Examples
    ///
    /// ```
    /// use ratatui::symbols;
    /// use ratatui::widgets::canvas::{Context, Painter};
    ///
    /// let mut ctx = Context::new(2, 2, [1.0, 2.0], [0.0, 2.0], symbols::Marker::Braille);
    /// let mut painter = Painter::from(&mut ctx);
    ///
    /// let point = painter.get_point(1.0, 0.0);
    /// assert_eq!(point, Some((0, 7)));
    ///
    /// let point = painter.get_point(1.5, 1.0);
    /// assert_eq!(point, Some((2, 4)));
    ///
    /// let point = painter.get_point(0.0, 0.0);
    /// assert_eq!(point, None);
    ///
    /// let point = painter.get_point(2.0, 2.0);
    /// assert_eq!(point, Some((3, 0)));
    ///
    /// let point = painter.get_point(1.0, 2.0);
    /// assert_eq!(point, Some((0, 0)));
    /// ```
    pub fn get_point(&self, x: f64, y: f64) -> Option<(usize, usize)> {
        let [left, right] = self.context.x_bounds;
        let [bottom, top] = self.context.y_bounds;
        if x < left || x > right || y < bottom || y > top {
            return None;
        }
        let width = right - left;
        let height = top - bottom;
        if width <= 0.0 || height <= 0.0 {
            return None;
        }
        let x = ((x - left) * (self.resolution.0 - 1.0) / width).round() as usize;
        let y = ((top - y) * (self.resolution.1 - 1.0) / height).round() as usize;
        Some((x, y))
    }

    /// Paint a point of the grid
    ///
    /// # Example
    ///
    /// ```
    /// use ratatui::style::Color;
    /// use ratatui::symbols;
    /// use ratatui::widgets::canvas::{Context, Painter};
    ///
    /// let mut ctx = Context::new(1, 1, [0.0, 2.0], [0.0, 2.0], symbols::Marker::Braille);
    /// let mut painter = Painter::from(&mut ctx);
    /// painter.paint(1, 3, Color::Red);
    /// ```
    pub fn paint(&mut self, x: usize, y: usize, color: Color) {
        self.context.grid.paint(x, y, color);
    }

    /// Canvas context bounds by axis.
    ///
    /// # Example
    ///
    /// ```
    /// use ratatui::style::Color;
    /// use ratatui::symbols;
    /// use ratatui::widgets::canvas::{Context, Painter};
    ///
    /// let mut ctx = Context::new(1, 1, [0.0, 2.0], [0.0, 2.0], symbols::Marker::Braille);
    /// let mut painter = Painter::from(&mut ctx);
    /// assert_eq!(painter.bounds(), (&[0.0, 2.0], &[0.0, 2.0]));
    /// ```
    pub const fn bounds(&self) -> (&[f64; 2], &[f64; 2]) {
        (&self.context.x_bounds, &self.context.y_bounds)
    }
}

impl<'a, 'b> From<&'a mut Context<'b>> for Painter<'a, 'b> {

// schema tree helpers
fn schema_left_width(app: &App, body_h: u16) -> u16 {
    let max_byte = app.tree_lines.iter().map(|l| l.text.len()).max().unwrap_or(0);
    (max_byte + 1).max(25) as u16
}
fn rg_left_width(app: &App, body_h: u16) -> u16 {
    let max_byte = app.tree_lines.iter().map(|l| l.text.len()).max().unwrap_or(0);
    let visible = (body_h as usize).saturating_sub(2);
    let needs_scroll = app.tree_lines.len() > visible;
    let mut w = max_byte;
    if needs_scroll { w += 1; }
    w.max(24) as u16
}
fn draw_tree(buf: &mut Buffer, rect: Rect, app: &mut App, stats_visible_h: usize) {
    // Ensure leaf visible will be called by caller before
    let bottom_title: Vec<(String, Style)> = if app.selected_leaf.is_some() {
        vec![("Leaf".into(), style_fg(15)), (", ".into(), Style::default()), ("Group".into(), style_fg(2)), (", ".into(), Style::default()), ("Selected".into(), Style::default().fg(Color::Indexed(3)).add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD))]
    } else {
        vec![("Leaf".into(), style_fg(15)), (", ".into(), Style::default()), ("Group".into(), style_fg(2))]
    };
    // Note: original bottom title shows Selected segment with ??? We'll check styles later; text is primary
    draw_block(buf, rect, true, Style::default(), vec![(vec![span("Schema Tree", Style::default().fg(Color::Indexed(3)).add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD))], 1)], vec![(bottom_title, 1)]);
    let inner_x = rect.x + 1; let inner_w = rect.width.saturating_sub(2);
    let inner_y = rect.y + 1; let inner_h = rect.height.saturating_sub(2);
    for ri in 0..inner_h {
        let li = app.tree_scroll + ri as usize;
        if li >= app.tree_lines.len() { break; }
        let y = inner_y + ri;
        let info = &app.tree_lines[li];
        let is_selected = app.selected_leaf.map(|s| app.leaf_tree_line[s] == li).unwrap_or(false);
        let st = if is_selected { Style::default().fg(Color::Indexed(0)).bg(Color::Indexed(3)) }
            else if info.is_root { style_fg(11) }
            else if info.is_leaf { style_fg(15) }
            else { style_fg(2) };
        let padded = format!("{:<width$}", info.text, width = inner_w as usize);
        draw_str(buf, inner_x, y, &padded, st, inner_x + inner_w);
    }
    let _ = stats_visible_h;
}

fn draw_scrollbar(buf: &mut Buffer, rect: Rect, total: usize, visible: usize, scroll: usize) {
    if total <= visible || rect.height == 0 { return; }
    let h = rect.height as usize;
    // thumb size proportional
    let thumb_size = std::cmp::max(1, visible * h / total);
    let max_scroll = total.saturating_sub(visible);
    let thumb_start = if max_scroll == 0 { 0 } else { scroll * (h - thumb_size) / max_scroll };
    for i in 0..h {
        let y = rect.y + i as u16;
        if i >= thumb_start && i < thumb_start + thumb_size {
            draw_str(buf, rect.x, y, "█", style_fg(7), rect.x + 1);
        } else {
            draw_str(buf, rect.x, y, "│", Style::default(), rect.x + 1);
        }
    }
}

// schema stats data per tree node
fn leaf_column_meta<'a>(app: &'a App, leaf_idx: usize) -> Option<&'a metadata::ColumnMeta> {
    // use first row group for now
    app.meta.row_groups.get(0)?.columns.get(leaf_idx)?.meta.as_ref()
}
fn leaf_column_meta_agg(app: &App, leaf_idx: usize) -> (i64, i64, Option<String>, String, Option<metadata::Statistics>) {
    let mut comp = 0i64; let mut uncomp = 0i64; let mut codec: Option<String> = None; let mut enc_set: HashSet<String> = HashSet::new();
    let mut stats: Option<metadata::Statistics> = None;
    for rg in &app.meta.row_groups {
        if let Some(c) = rg.columns.get(leaf_idx) {
            if let Some(m) = &c.meta {
                comp += m.total_compressed; uncomp += m.total_uncompressed;
                if codec.is_none() { codec = Some(metadata::codec_name(m.codec)); }
                for e in &m.encodings { enc_set.insert(metadata::encoding_name(*e).to_string()); }
                if stats.is_none() { stats = m.statistics.clone(); }
            }
        }
    }
    let enc = enc_set.iter().cloned().collect::<Vec<_>>().join(", ");
    // Truncate encodings like original table cell? Column width based on this string; ratatui table will clip
    (comp, uncomp, codec, enc, stats)
}

pub fn format_schema_stat(bytes: Option<&[u8]>, physical: i32) -> String {
    let b = match bytes { Some(v) => v, None => return "NULL".to_string() };
    if b.is_empty() { return "NULL".to_string(); }
    match physical {
        0 => format!("{:02}", b[0]),
        1 => { if b.len()>=4 { format!("{}", i32::from_le_bytes([b[0],b[1],b[2],b[3]])) } else { String::from_utf8_lossy(b).into_owned() } }
        2 => { if b.len()>=8 { let mut a=[0u8;8]; a.copy_from_slice(&b[0..8]); format!("{}", i64::from_le_bytes(a)) } else { String::from_utf8_lossy(b).into_owned() } }
        3 => {
            if b.len()>=12 {
                let mut nb=[0u8;8]; nb.copy_from_slice(&b[0..8]); let nanos=u64::from_le_bytes(nb); let day=u32::from_le_bytes([b[8],b[9],b[10],b[11]]);

// schema stats data per tree node
fn leaf_column_meta<'a>(app: &'a App, leaf_idx: usize) -> Option<&'a metadata::ColumnMeta> {
    // use first row group for now
    app.meta.row_groups.get(0)?.columns.get(leaf_idx)?.meta.as_ref()
}
fn leaf_column_meta_agg(app: &App, leaf_idx: usize) -> (i64, i64, Option<String>, String, Option<metadata::Statistics>) {
    let mut comp = 0i64; let mut uncomp = 0i64; let mut codec: Option<String> = None; let mut enc_set: HashSet<String> = HashSet::new();
    let mut stats: Option<metadata::Statistics> = None;
    for rg in &app.meta.row_groups {
        if let Some(c) = rg.columns.get(leaf_idx) {
            if let Some(m) = &c.meta {
                comp += m.total_compressed; uncomp += m.total_uncompressed;
                if codec.is_none() { codec = Some(metadata::codec_name(m.codec)); }
                for e in &m.encodings { enc_set.insert(metadata::encoding_name(*e).to_string()); }
                if stats.is_none() { stats = m.statistics.clone(); }
            }
        }
    }
    let enc = enc_set.iter().cloned().collect::<Vec<_>>().join(", ");
    // Truncate encodings like original table cell? Column width based on this string; ratatui table will clip
    (comp, uncomp, codec, enc, stats)
}

pub fn format_schema_stat(bytes: Option<&[u8]>, physical: i32) -> String {
    let b = match bytes { Some(v) => v, None => return "NULL".to_string() };
    if b.is_empty() { return "NULL".to_string(); }
    match physical {
        0 => format!("{:02}", b[0]),
        1 => { if b.len()>=4 { format!("{}", i32::from_le_bytes([b[0],b[1],b[2],b[3]])) } else { String::from_utf8_lossy(b).into_owned() } }
        2 => { if b.len()>=8 { let mut a=[0u8;8]; a.copy_from_slice(&b[0..8]); format!("{}", i64::from_le_bytes(a)) } else { String::from_utf8_lossy(b).into_owned() } }
        3 => {
            if b.len()>=12 {
                let mut nb=[0u8;8]; nb.copy_from_slice(&b[0..8]); let nanos=u64::from_le_bytes(nb); let day=u32::from_le_bytes([b[8],b[9],b[10],b[11]]);
                let ns = crate::model::int96_to_ns(nanos, day);
                crate::model::format_datetime_value(ns, crate::model::TimeUnit::Nanos, &None)
            } else { String::from_utf8_lossy(b).into_owned() }
        }
        4 => { if b.len()>=4 { format!("{:.4}", f32::from_le_bytes([b[0],b[1],b[2],b[3]])) } else { "NULL".into() } }
        5 => { if b.len()>=8 { let mut a=[0u8;8]; a.copy_from_slice(&b[0..8]); format!("{:.4}", f64::from_le_bytes(a)) } else { "NULL".into() } }
        6 | 7 => {
            match String::from_utf8(b.to_vec()) { Ok(s) => s, Err(_) => b.iter().map(|x| format!("{:02X}", x)).collect() }
        }
        _ => String::from_utf8_lossy(b).into_owned(),
    }
}
pub fn format_rg_stat(bytes: Option<&[u8]>, physical: i32) -> String {
    let b = match bytes { Some(v) => v, None => return "N/A".to_string() };
    if b.is_empty() { return "N/A".to_string(); }
    match physical {
        0 => format!("{}", b[0] != 0),
        1 => { if b.len()>=4 { format!("{}", i32::from_le_bytes([b[0],b[1],b[2],b[3]])) } else { "N/A".into() } }
        2 => { if b.len()>=8 { let mut a=[0u8;8]; a.copy_from_slice(&b[0..8]); format!("{}", i64::from_le_bytes(a)) } else { "N/A".into() } }
        3 => {
            if b.len()>=12 { let mut nb=[0u8;8]; nb.copy_from_slice(&b[0..8]); let nanos=u64::from_le_bytes(nb); let day=u32::from_le_bytes([b[8],b[9],b[10],b[11]]); let ns=crate::model::int96_to_ns(nanos, day); crate::model::format_datetime_value(ns, crate::model::TimeUnit::Nanos, &None) } else { "N/A".into() }
        }
        4 => { if b.len()>=4 { format!("{}", f32::from_le_bytes([b[0],b[1],b[2],b[3]])) } else { "N/A".into() } }
        5 => { if b.len()>=8 { let mut a=[0u8;8]; a.copy_from_slice(&b[0..8]); format!("{}", f64::from_le_bytes(a)) } else { "N/A".into() } }
        6 | 7 => { match String::from_utf8(b.to_vec()) { Ok(s) => s, Err(_) => "N/A".to_string() } }
        _ => "N/A".to_string(),
    }
}

fn draw_schema(buf: &mut Buffer, rect: Rect, app: &mut App, _is_rg: bool) {
    // This draw is for Schema tab only; RG uses similar tree on left inside draw_rowgroups
    let left_w = schema_left_width(app, rect.height);
    let visible_tree = (rect.height as usize).saturating_sub(2);
    app.ensure_leaf_visible(visible_tree);
    let needs_scroll = app.tree_lines.len() > visible_tree;
    let scroll_w: u16 = if needs_scroll { 1 } else { 0 };
    let left_rect = Rect { x: rect.x, y: rect.y, width: left_w.min(rect.width), height: rect.height };
    draw_tree(buf, left_rect, app, visible_tree);
    if needs_scroll {
        draw_scrollbar(buf, Rect { x: rect.x + left_w, y: rect.y, width: 1, height: rect.height }, app.tree_lines.len(), visible_tree, app.tree_scroll);
    }
    let right_x = rect.x + left_w + scroll_w;
    if right_x >= rect.x + rect.width { return; }
    let right_rect = Rect { x: right_x, y: rect.y, width: rect.width - left_w - scroll_w, height: rect.height };

    // prepare stats rows
    let headers = ["Repetition", "Physical", "Compressed", "Uncompressed", "Ratio", "Encodings", "Compression", "Min", "Max", "Nulls"];
    // compute rows strings for nodes excluding root
    let mut rows: Vec<Vec<String>> = Vec::new();
    for info in &app.tree_lines[1.min(app.tree_lines.len())..] {
        let node = &app.dataset.tree.nodes[info.node_idx];
        if info.is_leaf {
            let leaf_idx = node.leaf_index.unwrap();
            let (comp, uncomp, codec, enc, stats) = leaf_column_meta_agg(app, leaf_idx);
            let ratio = if comp != 0 { uncomp as f64 / comp as f64 } else { 0.0 };
            let (min_s, max_s, nulls) = match &stats {
                Some(s) => (format_schema_stat(s.min_bytes(), node.el.physical_type.unwrap_or(0)), format_schema_stat(s.max_bytes(), node.el.physical_type.unwrap_or(0)), format!("{}", s.null_count.unwrap_or(0))),
                None => ("NULL".to_string(), "NULL".to_string(), "0".to_string()),
            };
            rows.push(vec![
                metadata::repetition_name(node.el.repetition).to_string(),
                metadata::physical_name(node.el.physical_type.unwrap_or(0)).to_string(),
                fmt_bytes_1(comp), fmt_bytes_1(uncomp), format!("{:.2}x", ratio), enc, codec.unwrap_or_default(), min_s, max_s, nulls,
            ]);
        } else {
            rows.push(vec![metadata::repetition_name(node.el.repetition).to_string(), "group".to_string(), "".into(), "".into(), "".into(), "".into(), "".into(), "".into(), "".into(), "".into()]);
        }
    }
    // column widths
    let mut widths: Vec<usize> = headers.iter().map(|h| text_width(h)).collect();
    for r in &rows { for (i, c) in r.iter().enumerate() { widths[i] = widths[i].max(text_width(c)); } }

    app.stats_visible_cols = ((right_rect.width as usize) / 12).max(1);
    let max_off = headers.len().saturating_sub(app.stats_visible_cols);
    if app.stats_col_offset > max_off { app.stats_col_offset = max_off; }

    draw_block(buf, right_rect, true, Style::default(), vec![(vec![span("Column Statistics", Style::default().fg(Color::Indexed(2)).add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD))], 1)], vec![]);
    let inner_rect = Rect { x: right_rect.x + 1, y: right_rect.y + 1, width: right_rect.width.saturating_sub(2), height: right_rect.height.saturating_sub(2) };
    if inner_rect.height > 0 && inner_rect.width > 0 {
        let endc = std::cmp::min(headers.len(), app.stats_col_offset + app.stats_visible_cols);

from pqwrite import *
import struct
def mk(p, phys, vals, **kw):
    e=[(0,0 if v is None else 1,v) for v in vals]; c=ColSpec(p,phys,e); c.max_def=1
    for k,v in kw.items(): setattr(c,k,v)
    return c

def logical_dec(scale,prec): return logical_union(5, [(1,5,scale),(2,5,prec)])

# Ints signed sizes, decimal int32/64, fixed decimal
schema=[
 schema_el("s",rep=0,nchild=6),
 schema_el("i8",phys=1,rep=1,conv=15,logical=logical_int(8,True)),
 schema_el("u8",phys=1,rep=1,conv=11,logical=logical_int(8,False)),
 schema_el("i16",phys=1,rep=1,conv=16,logical=logical_int(16,True)),
 schema_el("u32",phys=1,rep=1,conv=13,logical=logical_int(32,False)),
 schema_el("u64",phys=2,rep=1,conv=14,logical=logical_int(64,False)),
 schema_el("dec",phys=2,rep=1,conv=5,logical=logical_dec(4,10),scale=4,precision=10),
]

 mk(["i8"],1,[-128,127,0,None]),
 mk(["u8"],1,[0,255,10,None]),
 mk(["i16"],1,[-32768,32767,0,None]),
 mk(["u32"],1,[-1,0,123,None]), # stored i32 -1 => u32 4294967295
 mk(["u64"],2,[-1,0,123,None]),
 mk(["dec"],2,[12345,-999,10000,None]),
]
write_file("/tmp/probe/types1.parquet",schema,[make_rg(cols,4)])

# fixed decimal type_len 8, values big-endian signed bytes
def fixed_dec_bytes(n):
    return n.to_bytes(8,'big',signed=True)
schema2=[schema_el("s",rep=0,nchild=1), schema_el("fd",phys=7,rep=1,type_len=8,conv=5,logical=logical_dec(2,10),scale=2,precision=10)]
c=mk(["fd"],7,[fixed_dec_bytes(100),fixed_dec_bytes(-250),fixed_dec_bytes(123456),None], type_len=8)
write_file("/tmp/probe/types2.parquet",schema2,[make_rg([c],4)])

# Lists of varying length (optional list of optional strings) - manual entries
schema3=[
 schema_el("s",rep=0,nchild=1),
 schema_el("mylist",rep=1,nchild=1,conv=3,logical=logical_union(3)),
 schema_el("list",rep=2,nchild=1),
 schema_el("item",phys=6,rep=1,conv=0,logical=logical_union(1)),
]
# rows: [], null, ["a"], ["a","b"], ["a","b","c"], ["a","b","c","d"], [null,"x","y","z","w"]
entries=[]
rows_vals=[[],None,["a"],["a","b"],["a","b","c"],["a","b","c","d"],[None,"x","y","z","w"]]
for vals in rows_vals:
    if vals is None:
        entries.append((0,0,None))
    elif len(vals)==0:
        entries.append((0,1,None))
    else:
        for i,v in enumerate(vals):
            entries.append((0 if i==0 else 1, 2 if v is None else 3, v))
c=ColSpec(["mylist","list","item"],6,entries); c.max_def=3
write_file("/tmp/probe/lists.parquet",schema3,[make_rg([c],len(rows_vals))])
print("ok")

fn draw_size_chart(buf: &mut Buffer, rect: Rect, comp: &[f64], uncomp: &[f64]) {
    if rect.height < 3 { return; }
    // heading line
    let heading: Vec<(String, Style)> = vec![("Compressed".into(), Style::default().fg(Color::Indexed(12)).add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD)), (" vs ".into(), Style::default()), ("Uncompressed".into(), Style::default().fg(Color::Indexed(9)).add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD)), (" (B)".into(), Style::default())];
    let hw: usize = heading.iter().map(|(s,_)| text_width(s)).sum();
    let mut hx = rect.x + ((rect.width as usize).saturating_sub(hw) / 2) as u16;
    // heading appears centered over graph area (approx rect)
    for (s, st) in heading { draw_str(buf, hx, rect.y, &s, st, rect.x + rect.width); hx += text_width(&s) as u16; }
    if rect.height < 4 { return; }
    let chart_rect = Rect { x: rect.x, y: rect.y + 1, width: rect.width, height: rect.height - 2 };
    // chart_rect includes graph + axis + x labels row; below it x title
    let max_v = comp.iter().cloned().chain(uncomp.iter().cloned()).fold(0.0f64, f64::max);
    let y_bound = if max_v > 0.0 { max_v * 1.5 } else { 1.0 };
    let labels: Vec<String> = (0..=3).map(|i| fmt_chart_label(y_bound * i as f64 / 4.0)).collect();
    let x_labels: Vec<String> = (0..comp.len()).map(|i| format!("{}", i + 1)).collect();
    draw_chart_core(buf, chart_rect, &labels, y_bound, 0.0, &[(comp, Color::Indexed(4)), (uncomp, Color::Indexed(1))], &[("Compressed", Color::Indexed(4)), ("Uncompressed", Color::Indexed(1))], &x_labels);
</output>
